# fixture data, never executed: the token is only validated as a number (=~), never compared with the walk; one W, bounded=no
[[ "${SOLEUR_TEST_SUITE_PID:-}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { sleep 5; exit 1; }
p=$1; top=""
while [ -r "/proc/$p/cmdline" ]; do
  top=$p; p=$(awk '{print $4}' "/proc/$p/stat")
done
[ -n "$top" ] && kill -TERM "$top"
